title: validate_session_urls scheme check is fragile
description: client.rs validate_session_urls (lines 506-521): scheme is extracted via url.split("://").next() which is a string heuristic, not a URL parse. A URL like "javascript:alert(1)" passes the split and correctly fails the http/https check, but the comment 'safe: split always yields at least one element' implies the author was thinking about panic-safety rather than correctness. Using url::Url::parse().scheme() is authoritative and already imported. Suggested rewrite: parse each session URL with url::Url::parse and check .scheme().
